questions.stem: A clinical psychologist is discussing personality disorders with a group of medical students. Which of the following statements regarding personality disorders is NOT true?
questions.stemHtml: A clinical psychologist is discussing personality disorders with a group of medical students. Which of the following statements regarding personality disorders is NOT true?

options.label: A
options.text: The prevalence of personality disorders in the general population is approximately 10%.

options.label: B
options.text: Personality disorders typically have an onset in adolescence or early adulthood.

options.label: C
options.text: Individuals with personality disorders usually perceive their thoughts and behaviors as ego-syntonic.

options.label: D
options.text: SSRIs are considered the first-line treatment for personality disorders.
